quests.instruction: Open your mouth wide, like you are at the doctor. Which word has that short a sound, like “ant”?
quests.hint: Short a is a wide, open sound. Drop your jaw as you say each word.
quests.explanation: “Map” has short a in the middle: /m/ /a/ /p/. “Mop” has short o and “mud” has short u.
quests.funFact: Short vowel sounds are quick and snappy. Long vowel sounds say the letter’s own name.

quests.instruction: What vowel sound do you hear in the middle of “cat”?
quests.hint: Say c-a-t slowly and pull out the middle sound.
quests.explanation: The middle sound in “cat” is short a, /a/. It sits between /k/ and /t/.
quests.funFact: Almost every English word has a vowel sound. In cat, it is the /a/ in the middle.

quests.instruction: Which word does NOT have the short a sound?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen only to the middle sound. Two words share a wide-open sound.
quests.explanation: “Van” and “tag” both have short a. “Pen” has short e, which is made with your mouth a little less open.

quests.instruction: Which word has the short e sound, like “egg”?
quests.hint: Short e is a relaxed sound with your mouth open just a little. Compare the middle sounds.
quests.explanation: “Net” has short e: /n/ /e/ /t/. “Nut” has short u and “nap” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which vowel do you hear in the middle of “hen”?
quests.hint: Say h-e-n slowly. Stretch out the middle sound.
quests.explanation: In “hen” the short e sits in the middle and says /e/.
quests.funFact: Short e is often spelled with the letter e, but not always. In “bread” it is spelled ea.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same middle sound as “bed”?
quests.hint: Listen to the middle of bed, then check each choice.
quests.explanation: “Bed” and “red” both have short e. “Rid” has short i and “rod” has short o.

quests.instruction: Which word has the short i sound, like “itch”?
quests.hint: Short i is a quick, light sound. Your smile stays small and your tongue stays high.
quests.explanation: “Bit” has short i. Changing only the vowel gives “bet” or “bat”, which are different words.
quests.funFact: In English, changing just one vowel sound can make a brand new word.

quests.instruction: Say “wig” slowly. What vowel sound is in the middle?
quests.hint: Break the word into three sounds. Which one is in the middle?
quests.explanation: “Wig” has three sounds: /w/ /i/ /g/. The middle sound is short i.

quests.instruction: Which word has the short i sound?
quests.hint: The three words begin and end alike. Listen for the one sound that changes.
quests.explanation: “Dig” has short i. “Dog” has short o and “dug” has short u.

quests.instruction: Which word has the short o sound, like “octopus”?
quests.hint: Short o is a round, open sound. Your mouth makes a wide circle.
quests.explanation: “Hot” has short o. “Hit” has short i and “hat” has short a.
quests.funFact: In “watch”, short o is spelled with the letter a. You will meet that pattern later.

quests.instruction: What is the middle sound in “log”?
quests.hint: Say l-o-g slowly. What sits between /l/ and /g/?
quests.explanation: The middle sound in “log” is short o, written with the letter o.

quests.instruction: Which word does NOT have the short o sound?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen to the middle. Two words sound round and open.
quests.explanation: “Box” and “mop” have short o. “Sun” has short u, a more relaxed sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the short u sound, like “up”?
quests.hint: Short u is a relaxed grunt, like when you say “uh”.
quests.explanation: “Cup” has short u. “Cap” has short a and “cop” has short o.

quests.instruction: Say “bug” slowly. What is the vowel sound in the middle?
quests.hint: Stretch the word out: b-u-g. Which sound is in the middle?
quests.explanation: “Bug” has the short u sound, /u/, between /b/ and /g/.
quests.funFact: The letter u can also say its own name, as in “cube”. That is a different sound you will learn later.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same middle sound as “sun”?
quests.hint: Listen to the middle of sun. Which other word has a sound that matches?
quests.explanation: “Sun” and “tub” both have short u. “Tab” has short a and “tip” has short i.

quests.instruction: A spider spins a w_b. Which vowel completes the word?
quests.hint: Say the sound the middle of the word makes. It is a relaxed, half-open sound.
quests.explanation: “Web” has short e in the middle. “Wab” and “wib” are not real words.

quests.instruction: Which two words have the same vowel sound?
quests.hint: Listen only to the middle sound of each word in the pair.
quests.explanation: “Bad” and “map” both have short a. “Bed” has short e and “bid” has short i.
quests.funFact: The vowel letters are a, e, i, o and u. Almost every English syllable has at least one vowel sound.

quests.instruction: Say “pet”, “pat” and “pit”. Which one has short a?
quests.hint: Short a is the widest vowel sound. Which word makes your mouth open widest?
quests.explanation: “Pat” has short a. “Pet” has short e and “pit” has short i.
quests.funFact: Pet, pat and pit all start with /p/ and end with /t/. Only the vowel changes.

quests.instruction: A h_t is something you wear on your head. Which vowel completes the word?
quests.hint: Think about the word you want, then say it slowly. Which vowel do you hear in the middle?
quests.explanation: The word is “hat”, with short a in the middle. “Hit” and “hut” are real words too, but they have different meanings.

quests.instruction: Which word does NOT have the same middle sound as the other two?
quests.hint: Say all three words. Two of them have a small, quick vowel.
quests.explanation: “Fin” and “fib” have short i. “Fan” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which word has the short o sound in the middle?
quests.hint: Round your mouth a little for this vowel.
quests.explanation: “Dot” has short o. “Dig” has short i and “den” has short e.
quests.funFact: A word with one vowel between two consonants, like fan, fin or dot, usually has a short vowel.

quests.instruction: Which two words have the same middle sound?
quests.hint: Say both words in a pair. Do their middle sounds feel the same?
quests.explanation: “Rug” and “bus” both have short u. “Rag” has short a and “rig” has short i.
quests.funFact: Short u is not always spelled with u. In “love”, it is spelled with the letter o.

quests.instruction: Which word has short o, not short u?
quests.hint: Short o is round and open. Short u is relaxed.
quests.explanation: “Fog” has short o in the middle. “Fig” has short i and “fun” has short u.

quests.instruction: You take a bath in a t_b. Which vowel completes the word?
quests.hint: Sound out the word that fits the sentence. What vowel is in the middle?
quests.explanation: The word “tub” has short u. “Tab” is a real word too, but it does not fit the sentence.

quests.instruction: Fill in the missing vowel: “Please s_t down on the mat.”
quests.hint: Read the sentence in your head with each vowel. Which one makes a real word that fits?
quests.explanation: “Sit” has short i and fits the sentence. “Sat” means something that already happened.

quests.instruction: Fill in the missing vowel: “The sun is h_t today.”
quests.hint: Try each vowel. Which word makes sense about the weather?
quests.explanation: “Hot” has short o. “Hat” and “het” do not tell us anything about the weather.

quests.instruction: Which word completes the sentence? “I wrote my name with a ___.”
quests.hint: Sound out each choice, then test it in the sentence.
quests.explanation: “Pen” has short e. You cook with a pan and sew with a pin, but you write with a pen.
quests.funFact: Pen, pan and pin begin and end with the same sounds. Only the vowel tells them apart.

quests.instruction: Which word has a different vowel sound from the other two?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen to the middle. Which one stands apart?
quests.explanation: “Win” and “wig” have short i. “Wet” has short e.

quests.instruction: Which vowel letter makes the middle sound in “hug”?
quests.hint: Say h-u-g slowly. Which short vowel is in the middle?
quests.explanation: “Hug” has short u. If you said /o/ you would make “hog”, and /i/ would make “hig”, which is not a word.

quests.instruction: Which list gives words that start with the short sounds of a, e, i, o, u in that order?
quests.hint: Go through the vowels in alphabet order, then check the first sound of each word.
quests.explanation: Ant (/a/), egg (/e/), itch (/i/), ox (/o/) and up (/u/) match the vowels in order.
quests.funFact: A, E, I, O and U are the five vowel letters. Each one has a short sound and a long sound.
